description: Official current dataset version, event universe, current codebook, and additional Coding Procedure remain unverified for this candidate stage.
required_followup: Compare against verified official bytes and current coding materials before any final eligibility or export decision.

description: Open web searching cannot reproduce LexisNexis or establish exhaustive coverage of Sierra Leonean media.
required_followup: Review accessible local and regional sources and document the coverage limits.

description: Politico SL and Premier News pages returned ordinary HTTPS 406 after web Cache misses; their bodies remain unread. A later Politico student-threat web open also returned Cache miss; the URL already had an HTTP 406 denial, so it was not retried. The Calabash article was accessible with ordinary HTTPS 200.
required_followup: Use only legitimately accessible independent contemporary sources; do not retry the denied URLs or infer article contents beyond the recorded search text.

description: Q002 (Sierra Leone first-week date-window probe) was executed and returned text, but post-call capture failed because the JS runtime lacked TextEncoder. Exact execution time and all result headers are unavailable; returned lists are null, not empty. The coordinator directed that it not be rerun.
required_followup: Keep this query as an uncaptured limitation; do not infer returned sources or count it as an observed empty search.

description: Two Cocorioko pages returned web-tool Internal Error without body/status; another returned HTTP429. One candidate URL is hosted on pages.dev with unverified BBC identity.
required_followup: Do not attribute the pages.dev result to BBC without independent verification; respect the recorded HTTP429 and do not repeat it.

description: The lecturers' work stoppage predates January. Primary ASA statements now establish a Nov 2020 resumption and a Jan 4, 2021 resumption after suspension through Dec 31; a government agreement and Njala Registrar notice report classes resuming Feb 3. Initial campaign onset remains unknown, and none of these records establishes an eligible public assembly or its ownership.
required_followup: Review contemporary local accounts for any distinct lecturer/student public assembly and its onset/turnout; consult the additional Coding Procedure and official baseline before assigning physical episode ownership.

description: No opened source reports turnout for a lecturers’ or student protest. The reported 40,000+ students were affected by closures, not shown attending a gathering.
required_followup: Locate a contemporaneous report of an actual public gathering and its attendance; do not use workforce, enrollment or meeting representation as crowd size.

description: Reports schedule the Vice President's lecturer meeting for Jan 19, while Politico's Jan 21 account says it ended yesterday (Jan 20 by relative wording). One SwitSalone paragraph misdates a release as Jan 4, 2020; the contemporaneous primary ASA statement explicitly dates its resumption notice to Jan 4, 2021 after a suspension through Dec 31. The conflict and apparent correction are retained.
required_followup: Check dated ASA, university, and government records; do not silently normalize the reported dates.

description: A Krio-oriented search returned no verified contemporaneous Krio-language article. English-language results dominated; no native-language review was performed.
required_followup: Review additional local-language archives or obtain fluent local review before any completeness claim.

description: The student union's threatened protest was conditional on reopening by Feb 3. Opened Calabash and SwitSalone reports do not document its execution; Njala's official notice reports academic activities commenced Feb 3. No source establishes whether students assembled before reopening or supplies turnout.
required_followup: Check contemporaneous Feb 1–4 local reports or student-union records for an executed assembly; do not infer either occurrence or nonoccurrence from the reopening notice.

description: Searches included Bo, Kenema, Makeni and other named districts and several worker sectors, but retrieved results were often from other years or did not yield opened regional/local reporting. Region-specific coverage remains uneven.
required_followup: Review accessible regional media and archives before any coverage or absence claim.

description: The Sierra Leone Observatory Digital News Review is a dated news digest/index, not independent corroboration; its included publishers and republication relationships are not fully mapped. Search-only secondary leads are not counted as confirmation.
required_followup: Trace digest items to original dated reporting and identify shared agencies or republication before treating reports as independent.
